subject: gk
question: In January 2022, in which city an initiative - Deaddiction, Reformation and Entrepreneurial Assistance for Making a Safe Society (Dreams) was launched to rehabilitate drug addicts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhubaneswar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In January 2022, in Bhubaneswar an initiative - Deaddiction, Reformation and Entrepreneurial Assistance for Making a Safe Society (Dreams) was launched to rehabilitate drug addicts.**
 
• **Drug addicts**, who were involved in **snatching**, **theft**, or **other property-related offence **in the city, may soon get a **fresh lease of life**.
 
• The **commission police **have decided to **facilitate **their treatment in **deaddiction centres**, bring them to the **mainstream **and provide them **livelihood support**.
 
• They will **initially **help **50 drug addicts **under their **new incentives**.
 
• Police will launch **awareness campaigns **in **slums **and **educational institutes **to make them **free from drugs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is to be noted here that the **city police **launched the **DREAMS project **in **February **this year with an aim to help the **drug addicts**, who were involved in **snatching, theft, **or **other property-related offences **in the city, to **return to normal life**.
 
• They were **engaged **in different **activities **like **yoga**, **dance**, and **playing chess**. **Proper food **and **other facilities **were provided at the **deaddiction centers **which helped the **drug addicts **to return to **normalcy now**.
